image:image.image:title: Akshay Nagpal
image:image.image:caption: Akshay leads product at a Series A startup in London, building AI-native consumer products. An Oxford MBA graduate, his background spans product management, data engineering and machine learning, with experience at ING Bank and Nokia. He’ll help teams sharpen their product ideas, design agentic AI workflows and turn early concepts into working products people love.

image:image.image:title: Alessandro Condorelli
image:image.image:caption: Alessandro is an AI Developer at London Business School, where he builds agentic AI systems and works on applying emerging technologies to real business problems. His background spans AI, analytics, finance, and entrepreneurship, with experience building solutions for organizations including LBS and Harrods. He can help teams turn early ideas into practical solutions, particularly around AI, data, and product development.
